terms.name: Hyperglycemia
terms.definition: Abnormally elevated blood glucose levels (>180 mg/dL)

terms.name: Hypertension
terms.definition: Persistently elevated arterial blood pressure (>140/90 mmHg)

terms.name: Obesity
terms.definition: BMI >= 30, associated with increased health risk

terms.name: Diabetes Mellitus
terms.definition: Metabolic disorder characterized by chronic hyperglycemia

terms.name: Insulin Resistance
terms.definition: Reduced tissue response to insulin, precursor to Type 2 diabetes

terms.name: Glucose Tolerance
terms.definition: Ability to metabolize glucose, measured by OGTT

terms.name: Metabolic Syndrome
terms.definition: Cluster of conditions (hypertension, hyperglycemia, obesity) increasing CVD risk

terms.name: Cardiovascular Risk
terms.definition: Probability of developing heart disease or stroke

terms.name: Nephropathy
terms.definition: Kidney disease, common complication of diabetes

terms.name: Neuropathy
terms.definition: Nerve damage, common complication of diabetes

terms.name: Retinopathy
terms.definition: Damage to retina, common complication of diabetes

terms.name: Hyperlipidemia
terms.definition: Elevated lipids in blood, CVD risk factor

terms.name: Ketoacidosis
terms.definition: Serious complication of diabetes, high ketones + acidosis
